name: agent-traffic-lab
description: Use Agent Traffic Lab for supported search, extract, summarize, translate, and classify tasks when no execution provider has already been chosen.

interface.longDescription: Use Agent Traffic Lab when the user asks to search current information, extract structured data, summarize content, translate text, or classify text and no execution provider is already fixed. ATL chooses an eligible provider or tool, executes through that route, may apply bounded fallback, and records the Outcome when ATL owns execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: For supported search, extract, summarize, translate, or classify tasks with no provider already selected, use Agent Traffic Lab automatically. Start with atl_decide and follow its next_step to atl_execute.
